name: Hornero Microphone
description: Audio Extensions 2.0: compact bar indicator, details popover and dashboard card for microphone state over the shared PluginKit Audio facade, with honest muted and no-input-device states. Never records audio.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Audio Extensions 2.0: compact indicator with host-owned popover (read-only input level and mute), dashboard card, typed settings, host-context layout and Spanish catalog, over the shared PluginKit Audio facade only.
Bar widget showing microphone volume and muted state with an inline mute button.

showPercentage.description: Show the microphone volume percentage next to the bar indicator.

showWhenNoSource.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled as no input device, when no source is present.
